prompt: A high-resolution, appetizing food photography poster featuring a close-up of freshly cooked Shanghai pan-fried buns (Shengjianbao). The buns are golden-brown and crispy on the bottom, topped with black sesame seeds and chopped green onions. Wisps of steam rise from the hot buns, emphasizing their freshness. The background is a dark teal gradient that transitions into a silhouette of the Shanghai skyline at night, including landmarks like the Oriental Pearl Tower. On the left side, there is a vertical layout of text and icons: large white Chinese characters '上海早安' (Good Morning Shanghai), followed by the date '2026-10-11 | Cloudy 23°C | Today starts with Shengjianbao'. Below this are three circular weather icons showing temperature (23°C), humidity (63%), and wind force (Level 2). Further down, stylized handwritten text reads '一座城 从一口热气开始' (A city begins with a mouthful of heat). At the very bottom left, English text says 'GOOD MORNING SHANGHAI' with a sun icon and smaller text '美好的一天 · 从上海味道开始' (A beautiful day starts with the taste of Shanghai). On the right edge, vertical red seal-style text reads '上海生煎包' (Shanghai Pan-Fried Buns) and '一口烟火 一座上海' (A bite of life, one Shanghai).

promptZh: 这是一张高分辨率、令人垂涎欲滴的美食摄影海报，特写展示了刚出锅的上海生煎包。生煎包底部金黄酥脆，表面撒有黑芝麻和葱花。热气腾腾的生煎包上方飘散着缕缕蒸汽，凸显其新鲜出炉的状态。背景采用深青色渐变，逐渐过渡为夜晚上海天际线的剪影，包括东方明珠塔等地标建筑。左侧采用垂直排版设计：醒目的白色中文字体“上海早安”，下方标注日期“2026-10-11 | 多云 23°C | 今日从生煎包开始”。再往下是三个圆形天气图标，分别显示温度（23°C）、湿度（63%）和风力（2 级）。接着是一行风格化的手写文字：“一座城 从一口热气开始”。左下角印有英文“GOOD MORNING SHANGHAI”并配有太阳图标，以及较小的中文标语“美好的一天 · 从上海味道开始”。右侧边缘则是竖排的红色印章风格文字：“上海生煎包”和“一口烟火 一座上海”。
